sourcePolicy: Freeze a committed clean source before measurement; every report-grade manifest must bind that same commit/tree. No src/tests drift from the current G4 certificate.

environment.reset: fresh complete project volumes before each repeat/configuration, including obs profile
environment.resourcePolicy: Configured CPU/memory limits must equal docker inspect; configured services, actual images and host fingerprint must match across repetitions within an experiment.

experiments.warmup: one real owned Driver, three scoped reserve/release cycles
experiments.oracle: read-only Driver row, one exact reserve intent, winner identity and exact post-measurement release at every point
experiments.limits: N=1 supplies only three request observations across resets; quantiles carry n and are not population latency/SLA claims.

experiments.warmup: 30 seconds: ten real concurrent preflight-Rider requests every three seconds, then finite declared telemetry readiness (75-second bound)
experiments.oracle: independent read-only Trip/Matching/Driver/Payment/provider state, no-fleet terminal closure and drained Outboxes; exact successful-response/idempotency agreement
experiments.limits: No Driver fleet. Measures authenticated public intake and no-driver resolution; expected active-Trip conflicts are separate. Payment/Saga are idle in this workload; their exercised correctness paths are separately certified by G4.

experiments.oracle: owning database unique durable intake with production work metadata, actual per-replica delivery logs, exact broker delivery/ACK totals, unique telemetry instances and finite measured metrics
experiments.limits: Application intake consumer replicas on one broker. Pending durable work is not completed rides. Observed ACK rate includes management-statistics visibility delay, recorded separately. Not RabbitMQ HA or maximum sustainable throughput.

statistics: Keep all planned runs; median/min/max/range across repetitions, per-run P50/P95 with sample counts, semantic outcomes and real achieved rates. Invalid setup diagnostics stay separately labelled; real bad outcomes cannot be silently discarded.
technicalGates: current-source G4 and exact-tree Linux CI
all declared metrics present and finite
three complete independent repetitions at every canonical point
final exact-tree CI and fresh post-merge main CI
humanReview: WAIVED by project-lead instruction; never claimed performed
